name: DocLayNet

size: 80,863 pages (69,375 train / 6,489 val / 4,999 test); core 28 GiB, extra 7.5 GiB; use the test split
download_status_here: not downloaded here: host not reachable from the sandbox (codait-cos-dax.s3.us.cloud-object-storage.appdomain.cloud)
notes: Range reads verify each member's CRC-32; the lock records each fetched file's sha256 and the archives' sizes and ETags.
